text: Create a single HTML file using vanilla JavaScript and Canvas 2D with MediaPipe Hands. STRICT IMPLEMENTATION RULES: VIDEO: - Draw video using ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, W, H) - DO NOT mirror the canvas - Apply overlay EXACTLY: rgba(0,0,0,0.12) STRING BEHAVIOR: - Use quadraticCurveTo for connections - Control point MUST be: midpoint + sin(frameCount * 0.04 + index) * 8 * t - The curve must be VERY SUBTLE (almost straight) - DO NOT scale amplitude with distance beyond this formula - Lines should appear nearly straight, not wavy THICKNESS: - thickness = lerp(4, 1.5, t) DISTANCE: - t = min(distance / (W * 0.8), 1) PARTICLES: - Spawn ~28 particles per burst - Gravity: vy += 0.12 - Friction: vx *= 0.97 - Trail length: max 6 INTERACTION: - Trigger only if distance < 30 - Cooldown: 400ms per fingertip pair JOINTS: - Fingertips: radius 7 glow 24 - Other joints: radius 4 glow 12 EXACT FEATURES: - Include scanlines - Include intra-hand faint lines - DO NOT include vignette (must be disabled) - DO NOT add new visual effects RENDER ORDER MUST BE: 1. clearRect 2. drawImage(video) 3. overlay rgba(0,0,0,0.12) 4. updateParticles 5. drawStrings 6. drawJoints 7. drawParticles 8. drawScanlines CONSTRAINT: - Do not invent new math - Do not exaggerate motion - Do not change numeric values - Match behavior exactly OUTPUT: - Only HTML code - No explanation
